name: pt-research-plugin
description: Auditable IYPT/CYPT research with equation lineage, physics-first routing, executable synthetic simulation packages, receipt-gated readiness, and validation-chain gates, plus mandatory industrial-grade research-software engineering and scientific-computing standards.

interface.longDescription: Build apparatus-faithful, evidence-backed causal models for IYPT/CYPT problems, compare alternatives and opposing evidence, trace every equation and parameter, identify regimes before selecting one primary solver, and prepare executable synthetic-runnable packages with truthful receipt-gated software and experimental readiness.
defaultPrompt: Research this IYPT problem and identify its physical essence.
Route this selected model to the right simulation method.
Resume this PT research case from its saved artifacts.
